statement: T.G.H. Strehlow recorded a vast corpus of Arrernte men's ceremonial songs in the 1950s (feeding Songs of Central Australia, 1971) but recorded no Arrernte women's songs. Significant recording of Arrernte women's songs did not occur until the 1990s, undertaken by Arrernte custodian Margaret Kemarre (M.K.) Turner together with linguist Jennifer Green. This is an observation about what got recorded and by whom (P13: not by itself a claim about suppression or content), directly explaining several UNKNOWN dimensions in this GenderSystem record.

sources.citation: Turpin, Myfany. "Finding Arrernte Songs." University of Sydney / ANU Open Research repository.
